title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC DELIVERED: +25bps → 3.75%–4.00%, unanimous (12-0), first Fed hike since 2023
Dot plot: 16/18 members see ≥1 more hike in 2026; Warsh withheld his own projections
Warsh press conf hawkish on inflation — Dow -600pts, S&P500 lower, 10y yield ~5.01%
BTC ~$75,400 — holding CLARITY/FOMC lows; no major new move post-decision
